figurative_meaning_en: back and forth, in various directions (indicating confusion or hesitation)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সাতপাঁচ ভেবে সে কাজটা আর হাতে নিল না।
আমরা সাতপাঁচ করে সময় নষ্ট করছি।
example_sentences_in_english: Thinking this way and that, he didn't take up the task.
We're wasting time dithering back and forth.
note: The idiom likely derives from numerical confusion, symbolizing disarray in thoughts or directions.
